title: Regulatory Obligations Register
description: A regime-agnostic rule-to-obligation-to-evidence register verdict: obligations in (rule_id, owner, control_ids, evidence_refs), coverage math out (owner and evidence percentages, control-linkage count, unassigned list, one FAIL finding per failing check, overall COVERED or GAPS_FOUND). Five stages in one pure compute() per OBLIGATIONS-REGISTER-BUILD-SPEC.md: intake with fail-closed shape validation, owner coverage, control linkage, evidence linkage, verdict. Owner and evidence coverage are the gated checks; control linkage is measured but never gates. The spec's worked example is carried as the oracle-backed golden fixture (pinned execution_hash bdf74ddc2f836c5e34b374d65f915e96684b061792283d775b08f2e9cd34ba67).

total.description: Obligations in the register. 0 on the fail-closed intake path.

owner_assigned.description: Obligations with a non-null non-empty owner.

owner_coverage_pct.description: owner_assigned / total as a percentage rounded to one decimal (66.7 for 2 of 3).

control_linked.description: Obligations with at least one control_id. Measured, never gated.

evidence_linked.description: Obligations with at least one evidence_ref.

evidence_coverage_pct.description: evidence_linked / total as a percentage rounded to one decimal (33.3 for 1 of 3).

unassigned.description: rule_id list of obligations with no owner, in input order. Empty on the fail-closed intake path.

findings.description: One FAIL finding per failing check; empty when every gated check passes. Passing checks emit nothing.

errors.description: Present only on the fail-closed intake path (malformed register), carrying the same string as the intake_validation finding's detail; non-empty exactly when the conditional compliance flag OBLREG_INTAKE_VALIDATION_FAILED is present (flag-mirror doctrine).

output_schema.x_schema_provenance: derived-from-golden-fixtures 2026-09-03 (22 vectors, incl. the spec-oracle worked example; errors observed on the 10 fail-closed vectors only)
